The incident occurred at Bu Ke Fried Chicken in Shenzhen, China, where the employee was working alone after a colleague took last-minute leave. The shop’s owner told local media that another employee was sent to assist and comfort the worker after the incident. Oriental Daily reports that the Longhua District Federation of Trade Unions conducted an investigation and found that the employee had suffered from “respiratory alkalosis” as a result of hyperventilation. The employee has since recovered and left Bu Ke Fried Chicken to work elsewhere. #mothershipabroad

I’ve been pleasantly surprised at how much I’m loving it here in China. Once you kind of understand where the people are coming from, they’re actually fairly nice (even though they sometimes sound like they are yelling at each other). We’re all just trying to make it in life. I’m grateful that I get to travel and see the world and experience different cultures. This isn’t me complaining, this is me being surprised and going along with it. I hope you all get to experience traveling to a place that makes you a little uncomfortable, it’s the best way to live and learn, I think :) ✈️🌎 #traveltips #china #cultureshock #traveltiktok #springbreak
